name: agent-progress
description: A progress bar above the prompt for the subagents Claude starts, and an Agents pane with each one's model, step progress, context, estimated cost and time. Based on Barncore's agent-watch and johnnyvizz's savvy-progress (MIT).

autoOpen.title: Open the Agents pane automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the pane the first time a subagent starts in a session

askForSteps.title: Ask subagents to report steps
askForSteps.description: Adds one line to each subagent's brief asking it to report its progress through the step tool, so its row shows a real progress bar
